proof.text: The spectrum of the function field is affine, hence qcqs. Mathlib quasiCompact_of_compactSpace and QuasiSeparated.of_quasiSeparatedSpace make the generic-point morphism quasi-compact and quasi-separated. For an affine etale object W over X, its base change along this morphism is qcqs by stability under base change and the source-space permanence lemmas.

Apply etale_sections_filtered_colimit to the original cocone after changing abelian groups to integer modules through the coefficient equivalence. The induced sheaf functor is isomorphic to composeAndSheafify, hence left adjoint and colimit preserving. The canonical module comparison is bijective and thus an isomorphism; nonempty_isColimit_iff_isIso_desc gives its image colimit. Reflect this colimit through the coefficient equivalence. This supplies continuity of abelian sections on each qcqs base-changed affine etale object.

Direct image is precomposition with etale base change, so its sections on W are exactly the sections used in the preceding step. Restriction to the affine etale basis is an equivalence by Mathlib Functor.isEquivalence_of_isOneHypercoverDense. Apply evaluationJointlyReflectsColimits to get the restricted presheaf colimit, reflect through sheafToPresheaf, and then through the basis equivalence. This proves that the direct-image cocone is colimit.

Apply sheafH_isColimit_large_filtered on X to this direct-image cocone for each natural degree q. Functor.mapCocone for a composite is definitionally the iterated image cocone, so the resulting proof has exactly the required conclusion.

theorem generic_torsion_cohomology_colimit
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (M : Sheaf (Spec X.functionField).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    {F : I ⥤ Sheaf (Spec X.functionField).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}}
    {ι : F ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj M}
    (hι : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk M ι))) :
    ∀ q : ℕ, Nonempty (IsColimit
      (((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X.fromSpecFunctionField) ⋙
        Sheaf.functorH X.smallEtaleTopology q).mapCocone (Cocone.mk M ι)))
